zoe_cs: Quick heads-up 1: NimbusCorp hit three budget alerts overnight. AM asked for a 1-slide cost summary + two remediation options for the QBR next Wed.
meter-bot: [automated] budget-alert nimbus.corp triggered 2026-07-12T02:03:11Z limit=800000 observed=1,050,210
frank_eng: I scanned logs: heavy ad-hoc full-document embeddings and a noisy analytics job re-triggering frequently. Sample: ```route=/v1/embeds model=embed-x tokens=980,412 requests=1,110``` Looks like re-ingest + low chunking.
kevin_solutions: Recommend short playbook: (A) immediate: client batching + 1hr prefix cache; (B) medium: switch to incremental diffs and dedupe. I can prep a 15-min enablement and a 1-pager checklist.
marta_fin: For the forecast slide, I'll need two scenarios: conservative (only short fixes) and target (full enablement). Estimate conservative = current *0.92, target = current *0.6 but need sim numbers.
oe: (typo)
frank_eng: I'll run a 48h canary with this minimal config:
```enable_prefix_cache: true
cache_ttl_seconds: 3600
chunk_size_tokens: 512
enable_batching: true
batch_window_ms: 25```
Expect ~25-35% token drop for this pattern. I'll post results by EOD tomorrow.
kevin_solutions: I'll draft the enablement slide and include quick code snippets for chunking + batching. Also will record a 10-min async walkthrough.
marta_fin: I'll draft two-priced commit asks: (1) 3mo cushion at list; (2) 6mo commit with milestone (>=25% reduction in 30d) for discount. Will add conservative numbers based on frank's sim.
zoe_cs: Action list: frank -> canary sim + per-route delta CSV by EOD tomorrow; kevin -> 1-pager + async vid by tomorrow; marta -> draft pricing + slide by Thu. I'll assemble QBR appendix Fri.
frank_eng: Permission to use sanitized request samples for sim?
zoe_cs: Legal cleared for redacted payloads (no PHI). Use secure drive.
kevin_solutions: Noted. I'll synth examples to avoid any sensitive content.
marta_fin: If canary confirms >=30% savings we push the 6mo commit ask; otherwise request 3mo cushion + follow-up.
zoe_cs: Thanks team 1. Keep updates concise here and ping AM once deck draft ready. :thumbsup:
